fact: Leaving the track and gaining a lasting advantage.
offence: Breach of Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that the car left the track at turn 11 and gained a lasting advantage. Car 20 and Car 44 were fighting for positions and this enabled Car 20 to stay ahead of Car 44. The Stewards noted that this was the second infringement of a similar nature during the session.
rules_referenced: Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
